version.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed image scanning and enhancement helper, but users should be careful because it uploads images to an external service and its trigger wording is broader than its actual image-only purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses that images are uploaded to Quark servers and that results are written to a temporary image directory; this is proportionate for cloud image enhancement, with privacy considerations for sensitive documents.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown-only and contains no embedded executable script, but it asks users to install the Python requests package without a pinned version or lockfile.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Most instructions are limited to image scanning/enhancement, but the trigger line also mentions generic file processing, document conversion, format conversion, and content extraction, which is broader than the documented supported image formats and scenes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It suggests storing SCAN_WEBSERVICE_KEY in persistent skill configuration or an environment variable, but shows no background service, startup hook, memory poisoning, privilege escalation, or tool hijacking behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is single-image document/photo enhancement using Quark Scan scenes such as handwriting removal, watermark removal, shadow removal, background cleanup, and line-art extraction; read, exec, write, API-key use, and external image processing fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending selected images or documents to Quark Scan for processing. Use it only for the listed image enhancement scenes, avoid sensitive files unless approved, keep the API key protected, and install Python dependencies in an isolated environment with pinned versions when possible.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger wording is artifact-supported and could cause over-invocation for non-image file tasks, but the surrounding documentation narrows actual use to single static image enhancement and explicitly notes external upload.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only presentation is a usability/localization limitation, not evidence of deceptive or unsafe behavior.
[T08] expected: The requests dependency is expected for a Python API client, but the unpinned install instruction creates ordinary supply-chain risk that users can reduce with a virtual environment and pinned dependencies.
